messages:
deploy-bot: deploy complete: v2.15.0 -> canary-usw2. kicking off post-deploy smoke (kvprobe, synths, healthchecks). dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/r/rollouts/2890004321 :mag:
alice: quick flag: kvprobe for prefix 'search-autocomplete' shows jittered miss rate + latency spikes at ~2890004350, p95 jumped 90ms -> 740ms. small sample but correlated with synths. :grimacing:
rachel: paste of kvprobe excerpt:
```
[2890004348] kvprobe miss prefix=search-autocomplete miss_rate=0.05 latency=85ms
[2890004349] kvprobe miss prefix=search-autocomplete miss_rate=0.47 latency=690ms trace=tx-8d7f
[2890004351] kvprobe miss prefix=search-autocomplete miss_rate=0.10 latency=120ms
```
marco: synth /autocomplete also returned a couple 504 upstream_timeout around same window. trace ids attached.
pradeep: infra metrics show a transient spike in kernel fallback and a short-lived host GC on one canary node at 2890004347. might be noisy but worth watching.
ops-bot: incident candidate flagged: kvprobe-jitter (severity: low). Recommend limiting canary traffic to affected prefixes while triaging.
alice: proposal: partial pin routing for /search-autocomplete to v2.14.3 (stable) while leaving other routes on v2.15.0. that will limit blast radius and keep other rollout progress.
rachel: command to apply: ```redwoodctl routing set --route /search-autocomplete --version v2.14.3 --percent 100 --reason "postdeploy kvprobe jitter"```
marco: +1. please apply and note audit id.
alice: applying now... :running_woman:
deploy-bot: routing change applied by alice at 2890004365. audit id r-audit-9513.
alice: after pin, observed p95 drop to ~110ms within ~50s, synth 504s cleared. good signal. :thumbsup:
pradeep: I'll collect heap profiles and kernel-selection diffs from the canary node that GC'd. linking traces: https://traces.redwood.ai/tx-8d7f.
marco: I'll add an entry to the release notes about the temporary pin and observed symptom, and open a follow-up ticket RINF-5011 "v2.15 kvprobe jitter on autocomplete prefix" assigned to serving-ops + infra.
ops-bot: scheduled 15m recheck reminder. If issue recurs or affects additional prefixes escalate to full rollback.
alice: action items: alice monitor for 15m, pradeep collect logs + heap + kernel diffs, marco update release notes & ticket, rachel attach kvprobe heatmap. reconvene if recurrence.
marco: note for postmortem: consider adding a canary probe targeted at prefix-level warmup to catch prefix-hotspots during kernel selection changes.
alice: 10m update: stable so far. leaving thread open for triage notes. :white_check_mark:
